name: reciprocating_catalogue_r717
title: Reciprocating compressor from catalogue data (R717)
summary: Isentropic and volumetric effectiveness of an R717 reciprocating compressor computed from 17 catalogue rows (condensing/evaporating temperature, capacity, electrical power, mass flow) read from a lookup table, with a power-law extrapolation of the isentropic effectiveness to 1000 and 750 rpm.

origin.course: Laborelec compressor toolkit 2002 (reviewers J. Lebrun, E. Winandy)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (645 variables stored, 381 of the active model); the runnable variant reciprocating_catalogue_r717_coolsolve.eescode is verified, the native file cannot run
verification.notes: 381 common variables, 51 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 18. The 51 are the absolute h/s (reference-state offset EES vs CoolProp R717: h +145.1..145.5 kJ/kg, s +482.2..482.9 J/kg-K); all 330 derived results pass rtol (worst 9.96e-4).

history.action: added (blocked native file, verified runnable variant)
